title: ProgressionRPGMob
description: Custom RPG mob spawner with configurable stats, names, and abilities — place named mobs at fixed locations that respawn automatically after death.
body:
# 👾 ProgressionRPGMob

ProgressionRPGMob lets you place named custom mobs at fixed world locations. Each mob has configurable health, damage, display name, and abilities. When killed, they respawn after a configurable delay — perfect for dungeon bosses, world guards, and repeatable farming spots.

No mob spawner blocks. No timers to manage. Place the mob, configure it once, and it just works.

## Features

- **Fixed-location spawning** — mobs are placed at exact coordinates
- **Configurable stats** — health, damage, speed, follow range per mob type
- **Custom display names** — full MiniMessage/color support
- **Auto-respawn** — configurable respawn delay after death
- **Mob editor** — edit placed mobs in-world without editing files
- **Save/load system** — all placements survive restarts
- **Admin tools** — give spawn tool, list, remove, reload

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/prpgm give` | Get the mob placement tool |
| `/prpgm save <name>` | Save current mob config as a template |
| `/prpgm edit <name>` | Edit a placed mob |
| `/prpgm list` | List all placed mobs |
| `/prpgm remove <name>` | Remove a placed mob |
| `/prpgm reload` | Reload config |

## Dependencies

Requires **ProgressionAPI**.

---
Part of the **Rosewood Progression** ecosystem — built for RPG and MMO-style Paper servers.
